title: Test name no longer matches updated behavior
detail: Test docstring now says 'Shortlisted and Viewed columns' but the function name still says 'only_on_shortlisted'. A reader searching for Viewed CTA tests by function name will miss this one.

title: focus_index_for_status still omits 'submitted' — keyboard focus lands nowhere for the first pipeline stop
detail: The function was extended for viewed but still returns None for 'submitted' via the wildcard. The stepper now has 5 stops (0–4); stop 0 (Submitted) has no focus-index mapping. This was pre-existing but the pipeline refactor was the right moment to fix it.
recommended_fix: Add `"submitted" -> Some(rank(application.Submitted) - 1)` arm before the wildcard.

title: Orphaned closing parenthesis in status_from_string doc comment
evidence:
-/// `application_status` enum is NOT NULL and constrained to these six values).
+/// `application_status` enum is NOT NULL and constrained to these seven values).
detail: The closing ').' has no matching opening parenthesis. Pre-existing from the original 'six values).' line — this diff touched the line but carried the typo forward.
recommended_fix: Either add an opening paren or remove the orphaned ')'.

title: slug_for_index wildcard silently maps out-of-range indices to 'approved'
detail: The wildcard default catches index 4 (correct for the 5-stop pipeline) but also any index ≥5. If a bug corrupts the focus index, it silently maps to 'approved' rather than surfacing the error. Pre-existing pattern from the 4-stop pipeline.
recommended_fix: Replace `_ ->` with explicit `4 -> "approved"` and add a second wildcard that logs or returns a sentinel.
